events.title: AI and Economic Security | Betting on America
events.description: Special episode of Betting on America looking back on a year in which AI moved from a technology story to a policy and political issue, with insights from government, business, academia and investors.
events.why: CSIS Economic Security and Technology recap of the year's AI policy debate; online.

events.title: CMMC on Hold: Charting a Path Forward
events.description: All About the Base episode: Jerry McGinn and PSC president Stephanie Sanok Kostro on DoD's CMMC pause, compliance costs, and cybersecurity across the defense industrial base.
events.why: Defense-contractor cybersecurity rules are a live cyber-policy fight; short online episode.

events.title: Full Committee Hearing - Weathering the Solar Storm: Advancing America's Space Weather Capabilities
events.location: 2318 Rayburn House Office Building, Washington, DC
events.host: House Science, Space, and Technology Committee
events.description: Hearing on US space weather forecasting and resilience with NASA Heliophysics director Joseph Westlake and NWS director Ken Graham.
events.why: House Science hearing on space weather capabilities; open to the public on the Hill.

events.title: Hearing: Worldwide Threats to the Homeland: 25 Years After 9/11
events.location: 310 Cannon House Office Building, Washington, DC
events.description: Annual worldwide threats hearing of the House Homeland Security Committee; typically covers cyber, China and emerging-technology threats alongside terrorism.
events.why: Annual threats hearing where cyber and China tech threats usually feature; public, on the Hill.

events.title: Hearing: Protecting Main Street, Securing America: Examining Cybersecurity Challenges for Small Business Contractors
events.location: 2360 Rayburn House Office Building, Washington, DC
events.host: House Small Business Subcommittee on Contracting and Infrastructure
events.description: Subcommittee hearing on cybersecurity compliance burdens (e.g. CMMC) and threats facing small-business federal contractors.
events.why: Hill hearing on cyber rules for defense and federal contractors; ties to the CMMC debate.

events.title: Senate HSGAC nominations hearing: Michael LoSapio to be CISA Director and others
events.location: 342 Dirksen Senate Office Building, Washington, DC
events.host: Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs
events.description: Hearing to examine nominations including Michael LoSapio of New Jersey to be Director of the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency.
events.why: Confirmation hearing for the next CISA director: a direct read on federal cyber policy.

events.title: Hearing: The Hidden Chokepoint: China's Dominance in Pharmaceuticals
events.location: 2200 Rayburn House Office Building, Washington, DC
events.host: House Foreign Affairs Subcommittee on East Asia and the Pacific
events.description: Subcommittee hearing on US dependence on China for pharmaceuticals and active ingredients as a supply-chain and security chokepoint.
events.why: China supply-chain leverage in pharma/biotech, a growing strand of tech-competition policy.

events.title: House Select Committee on the CCP hearing (title TBA)
events.location: 210 Cannon House Office Building, Washington, DC
events.host: House Select Committee on the CCP
events.description: Select Committee hearing, rescheduled from Nov 19 10:00 to Nov 20 8:30-10:30 am; title not yet posted.
events.why: China Select Committee hearings usually bear on tech competition; note the new date and time.

events.title: 2026 Aspen Security Forum: DC Edition
events.description: The Washington edition of the Aspen Security Forum, a day of on-record conversations with senior national security officials and experts.
events.why: Senior officials on record about security and technology competition, in DC.

events.title: Architects of the New Economy
events.description: Semafor convening on the post-midterm power players shaping American industry, technology, markets and government. Invitation by request.
events.why: On-record policymakers on the economic and tech agenda after the midterms; invite request needed.

events.title: NVIDIA GTC Washington, D.C.
events.description: NVIDIA's DC conference on AI, accelerated computing and public-sector innovation, Nov 30-Dec 3, with policymaker sessions and many side events (Luma 'NVIDIA GTC DC' calendar).
events.why: Big AI-industry gathering in DC with policy tracks and side events; mostly paid.

events.title: Tech Tonic: NVIDIA GTC Keynote Watch Party
events.description: Vendor-hosted watch party for the NVIDIA GTC Washington, D.C. keynote with government and industry attendees.
events.why: Vendor networking event around the GTC keynote; little policy content.

events.title: Submarine Technology Symposium 2027
events.location: Kossiakoff Center, Johns Hopkins APL, Laurel, MD
events.host: Johns Hopkins APL / Naval Submarine League
events.description: Annual symposium on undersea warfare technology at APL; attendance is restricted and typically requires clearance.
events.why: Specialist defense-technology symposium with restricted attendance.

events.title: Securing Freedom: Innovation, Industry, and the Future of Deterrence
events.location: Hoover Institution, Stanford University, Stanford, CA
events.description: Advance screening of 'Deterrence: Winning the 2nd Cold War' and a conversation with Palantir CTO Shyam Sankar and H.R. McMaster.
events.why: Defense-tech and deterrence with a leading industry voice, at Stanford.

events.title: Logan Wright | Broken China: How the Economic Miracle Shattered and What it Means for the World
events.location: Shultz Auditorium, George P. Shultz Building, Hoover Institution, Stanford, CA
events.description: Rhodium Group partner Logan Wright on his book about the end of China's growth model and its global consequences.
events.why: China's economic trajectory frames its tech and industrial policy; public lecture at Stanford.
